text: The screen is reached from the navigation entry `Customers › Customer notes`, with the icon the spec's screen block names.

comments.text: The spec's screen block names no icon (only `for`, `menu` and `mock`). The design and Task 3 both tell the implementer to use an icon from the spec that does not exist. Either drop the icon requirement or name the icon explicitly in the design.

text: Notes saved without a date sort after dated ones.

comments.text: This null-ordering behaviour is asserted in the design but no task or criterion implements or verifies it. Task 2's query only says 'orders by createdDate descending'. Either state the null-last ordering in Task 2 and add a criterion, or remove the claim from the design.

text: - (A3) The navigation entry `Customers › Customer notes` is registered and opens the screen, which shows the notes in the standard table layout with the selected row's form beside it.

comments.text: This criterion bundles navigation, screen open, table layout and side-panel form into one check, and it cites only A3 even though it also verifies the newest-first list on screen. Split into separate checkable criteria (navigation entry opens the screen; table lists newest first via the sheet; selected row shows the default form).
